walls.note: Front of the group from the bench side: the Commons photos (Statues in Johnny Jordaanplein 01-03, 2024 Johnny Jordaanplein ...) show every bronze, plinth and the lettered bench; the panorama shows the same arrangement with the faces blurred.

items.where: standing double-bass player with the bass in front of him on a granite block with a bronze slab
items.how: builder: figure kit (stout standing man, arms raised to the neck and low), bass from two ellipsoids, neck and scroll

items.where: bust of Tante Leen on a granite pillar inscribed TANTE LEEN 1912 1992
items.how: builder: bust kit (torso, shoulders, neck, head with curled hair) and raised name and years

items.where: bust of Johnny Jordaan with thick glasses and a bow tie on a pillar inscribed JOHNNY JORDAAN 1924 1989
items.how: builder: bust kit with glasses, lapels and bow tie, raised name and years

items.where: accordionist Johnny Meijer seated on a bentwood chair on a bronze slab, accordion with bellows
items.how: builder: seated figure from the figure kit, chair of a seat disc, four legs and a ring, accordion from two end boxes and nine bellows folds

items.where: half-length man with an accordion and a woman standing behind and above him on the biggest block, plaque with the Amsterdam crosses
items.how: builder: two busts on torso masses, accordion box and bellows, forearms; the plaque is a plain plate

items.where: semicircular concrete bench with wooden seats and raised bronze letters JOHNNY JORDAAN PLEIN
items.how: builder: extruded ring sector, wooden seat sectors, letterBoxes tangent to the arc

walls.note: Backs of the bronzes and plinths: not photographed in the open set; plain.
